name: Cube
description: The two clips are faces of a box that turns a quarter turn in perspective above a reflective floor. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: unzoom
params.description: How far the camera pulls back mid-turn, as a part of the frame

params.name: floating
params.description: Gap between the box and its reflection, in percent of the frame height

params.name: shading
params.description: How much the faces darken as they turn away, and the shadow on the floor
